_help: Scapulohumeral rhythm. Each list = [humerothoracic elevation (deg), change from the arm-at-side position (deg)]; positive = the named direction. Edit freely and reload; the viewer interpolates linearly. Defaults are approx: upward rotation 0 until 30 deg then 0.4 deg/deg (~2:1 GH:ST); tilt and clavicle values near the bone-pin means of Ludewig 2009 (JBJS Am). Seth 2016 data could not be downloaded.

limits._help: Humerothoracic plane of elevation: 0 = abduction (coronal), 90 = flexion (sagittal), -90 = extension, >90 = cross-body. Rotation: + = external. Elbow: 0 = straight. Supination: 0 = thumb up, + = supination. maxElevationByPlane = [plane, max elevation].
